dedupe_keys.name: report on third round of benchmarks

description: Sanz Rodrigo, Javier and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented benchmark programme compares wind-flow modelling approaches across completed rounds and related forest-site evaluations. The third-round record is grouped with earlier round reports and numerical-method context, preserving the distinction between completed findings and later proposed extensions. This case supports assessment of model skill and uncertainty for wind-resource applications. It is not a new independent dataset for every publication or proof that all models performed equally across every participating benchmark. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
